name: EPAKIM1 Trader Mod
teaser: Trader mod that adds in the popular and up-and-coming artist "Epakim1" and his characters and art work into the world of Tarkov. With custom quests included!
description_html:
This mod requires Virtuals Custom Quest Loader in order to operate!!!

Introducing my first attempt at a mod, in homage to an artist that of whom’ artwork I extremely enjoy.

This trader mod includes just under 10 fully custom quests made possible by Virtual and his excellent and “easy” to grasp mod; VCQL.

As well as a fully custom and arranged menu of barters and tradeable items. This trader features levels 1 - 4 trades in correspondence with the players “affinity” towards the trader themself!

All artwork used for every single quest/thumbnail is artwork created by Epakim1. Check out their amazing and kickass artwork and socials at the following: EPAKIM1

Disclaimer: { EPAKIM himself has given me permission to utilize his awesome artwork for this mod, in both discord VC and DMs. }

If you have any criticisms or any sort of feedback, please leave a comment and let me know what can be improved. I will try to maintain this mod in accordance to the updates of SPT in between my work hours and such.

Have fun and get to work errand boys.

Ensure you copy and paste every folder file within the link folder.

Ensure you install VCQL FIRST then Epakim1 and select the replace folders option.

{Update: Fixed multiple items in Epakim’s inventory that were unable to be purchased.} 5/2/25

{Update: Added altyn faceshield as a barter in a later trader lvl tier.} 5/15/25

{08/04/2025 - Fixed trader affinity scoring per mission rewards to allow for mastery of the trader.}

{Update: New Quest & Russian translation added. 8/22/2025
